einzeiler: Security guards experience terrifying paranormal activity at the Capitol Theatre.
kurzfassung: New security officer Dave Murphy experiences unexplained phenomena during his night shifts at the Capitol Theatre in Salt Lake City. Other staff members and guards report similar terrifying encounters with a hooded apparition, slamming doors, and phantom elevator rides. Historical research later reveals a fatal fire in the 1940s that claimed the life of an usher trapped in the basement.
stichpunkte: In August 2006, rookie officer Dave Murphy begins night security duties at the historic Capitol Theatre.
During his rounds, Dave hears a heavy bathroom door slam shut with no one inside, and later finds all second-floor lights turned back on.
Senior accountant Blair Fuller tells Dave he refuses to work nights after experiencing an empty elevator moving on its own and filing cabinets slamming shut.
Dave's partner Morgan confesses to hearing whispers and smelling smoke in the basement during a solo shift.
To test their theories, Dave and a neutral friend, Greg, tour the locked theatre after hours and witness a basement storage door slam and shake violently.
Following the installation of new infrared cameras, Morgan spots a hooded figure with glowing red eyes sitting in the auditorium before it vanishes into the ceiling, prompting him to quit.
Dave encounters autonomous ragtime piano playing in the pitch-black basement before demanding a transfer.
Veteran cop Josh Thomas takes over full-time security and calls for backup after experiencing a phantom elevator ride and encountering the same hooded figure in the auditorium.
Historical records reveal a fatal 1940s theatre fire where a young usher died trapped in the basement, providing a potential explanation for the haunting.
beschreibung:
Welcome back to the Campfire! I have a great story to tell. It's a classic ghost story – and not only are the elements in the story quite unnerving, but it also has a high degree of believability. There are quite a few people in this story who, independently, witnessed and experienced these events.

Be sure to WATCH this episode on my YouTube channel on Friday, August 21st!
